name: ATS_CORE
description: Applicant tracking core: requisitions with structured must/nice skills and an approval, candidates with a mandatory DPDP consent record (purpose, notice version, retention date), contact data stored apart from evaluation data, applications and pipeline stages with allowed transitions, a human-only decision log, duplicate review (no auto-merge), candidate export and erasure, and a retention sweep that lists what is due (a person approves each deletion). Ledger entries hold hashes only. It never ranks, scores or decides about a person.
